Only the private first cause/stage and the earlier prefix differ, and up to 4096 budget-bounded tuples are frozen before the refusal. No test covers counts 17..4096, which is how this went unnoticed.

info.text: Order of refusals when several sources are missing in 02_SOURCES (p02_evaluate_internal.go:121-124). Go checks ticket&&clock (TIME) before measurement (INSTALLATION). The design checks h5 (INSTALLATION) before clock (TIME). So ticket present + clock and H5 both missing gives TIME in Go but INSTALLATION in the design. Separately, the pre-stage budget refusal (OWNERSHIP) comes before the nil-capsule check (ANCHOR); both are 01_ANCHOR. With a single missing source the two agree, and the design's targeted cases are single-fault. Fail-closed; optional to align.

Go is stricter than the design in several places, all fail-closed. Lifecycle floor must be > 0 (:549). Clock, lifecycle, ticket and H5 times must be in the epoch domain (:571-580). Ticket id must be non-empty (:562). Raw coverage evidence, H5 evidence and the artifact must be non-empty (:418, :493, :482). Readback uses a structured token bound to capsule/generation/selector/scope/record identity/version/ticket/H5 digest, instead of the design's opaque v0==v1 (:587). rootChoiceSHA256 is computed over the raw H3-EA evidence bytes instead of trusting a claimed field (:418; this moves toward P02R2-I2, but binding those bytes to the typed statement is still the producer's job, as the README says). C2 is ASCII-only, which is equivalent after schema validation because every authority-scope string is printable ASCII. None of these turns a design refusal into acceptance. Some could refuse inputs the design would accept (for example floor 0). A future contract delta should list them explicitly.

README.md:175-176 (frozen published bytes) still says 'At this WIP checkpoint its Go tests are NOT_RUN'. Root actually ran 23 top-level / 228 subtests on these exact bytes before publication. The sentence is time-stamped as a WIP checkpoint and points toward less assurance, not more, but it is stale. The publication cut kept the 14 bytes frozen; update it in the next code cut. Root's original receipts are authoritative.

Precision note for P02R3-I1. p02Expectation kinds 'a'/'o' carry no content (p02_canonical_internal.go:21-24), so a present non-empty array or object expectation cannot be expressed in the typed capsule. It can only appear as a raw-vs-typed mismatch, which refuses ANCHOR at 01. Present empty []/{} and int/bool/null/empty-string/129-byte values reach 05 closed-independent-effective-verdict-expectation, and non-printable values refuse at 01, as P02R3-I1 recorded. Fail-closed.
